report:
Fresh review started with the current coordinator instructions; assessed the current complete claim, four ordinary implementation entries, and both ordinary associated tests. No TODO or N/A evidence exists. This is source inspection, not a claim of new test execution; the coordinator is running central suites.
Requirement 1: warning-by-default lints are individually allowed using the pinned compiler inventory. quiet_lints calls metadata::our_rustc with -W help, selects exactly warn rows, excludes the warnings group, constructs individual -A{name} flags, rejects unrecognized inventory lacking dead-code, and caches the result. check calls the same compiler and appends those flags. metadata::our_rustc resolves the embedded sysroot's bin/rustc; captured build.rs supplies SAGE_SYSROOT. These account for the two rustc implementation entries and the metadata entry.
Requirement 2: incidental unused-item and naming warnings disappear from ordinary fixtures. The complete associated rustc_is_mandatory_and_warnings_can_be_enabled_in_source test prepares fn unused and fn nonSnakeCase without markers, so an unsuppressed dead_code or non_snake_case warning fails the preparation assertion. The pinned_rustc test also compiles unused functions without warning markers.
Requirement 3: deny-by-default lints remain active. The inventory filter does not select deny rows, and no blanket allow or cap flag is passed. pinned_rustc_checks_errors_editions_and_normal_library_configuration requires an ERROR for the overflowing u8 literal 256; matching would fail if the deny-by-default overflow disappeared.
Requirement 4: source attributes may reenable warnings or deny them, and resulting diagnostics require matching markers. The source-override test enables warn(dead_code), asserts missing markers cause a rustc-specific 0 markers/1 diagnostics error, then accepts the corresponding WARN if rustc fixture. It separately accepts deny(dead_code) with ERROR if rustc. The observe::match_compiler_diagnostics implementation entry filters applicable markers, matches exact severity and source location, and requires a complete one-to-one assignment; missing or extra diagnostics cannot succeed. Captured annotations.rs defines warning/error kinds and compiler conditions; captured mod.rs shows preparation passing markers into rustc and propagating errors. Rustc parsing retains warning/error severity and excludes only presentation summaries from matching.
Requirement 5: this is not a lint cap and hard language errors survive. The complete invocation contains individual allows and no cap. Source warn/deny overrides provide behavioral discrimination against a suppressive cap. The pinned_rustc test asserts the hard bool-to-u8 type error fails without a marker and succeeds with ERROR. Its 2021/2024 IntoFuture and cfg cases additionally confirm ordinary compiler execution settings; those cases do not substitute for the lint assertions.
The current private execute and validate_output helpers preserve the quiet-lint arguments and feed compiler diagnostics into the exhaustive matcher. Tests visibly contain fixtures and substantive success/failure assertions. Captured dependencies and initial implementation files cover the behavior relied upon in this assessment. No source edits or test runs were performed during this refresh; review start/read/record are the commands used for this source assessment. All aspects are accounted for, with no requested edits.
